evidence: TiO2 thin ﬁlms were grown by an atomic-layer-deposition process at growth temperatures ranging from 200 to 300°C on Ru and Si substrates using Ti /H20851OCH/H20849CH3/H208502/H208524 and H 2O as metal precursor and oxygen source, respectively, for metal-insulator-metal capacitor application in dynamic random access memories.
